Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 104. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

Choose a class: Mystic or Agent. You learn two cantrips
of your choice from a branch of Magic that is available
to them
In addition, choose one 1st-level spell to learn from
that same list. Using this feat, you can cast the spell
using stamina equal to twice the spell’s level.
Your spellcasting ability for these spells depends on
the class you chose: Charisma for Mysitcs or
Intelligence for Agents.
